title: Gateless Barrier, Case 31: Chao-chou Investigates the Old Woman
speaker: Nomon Tim Burnett
summary: The talk emphasizes the importance of letting go of preconceptions and assumptions in order to find one's own path forward, especially in uncertain times. By taking a step back from external expectations and distractions, we can cultivate kindness, compassion, and connection with ourselves and others, ultimately tapping into a deeper sense of freedom and rest in the present moment. This approach encourages us to trust our intuition and guidance, rather than relying on external sources or predictability.
